posts.text: PM Modi appeals to states to take all possible measures to protect citizens from the ongoing heatwave. Also highlights progress on infrastructure, clean energy, and regional development across the nation.
posts.caption: PM Modi appeals to states to take all possible measures to protect citizens from the ongoing heatwave. Also highlights progress on infrastructure, clean energy, and regional development across the nation.

posts.text: India's aviation sector soars with new infrastructure projects across the country. Wings India 2026 paves the way for the future of Indian aviation — innovation, sustainability, and safety at the forefront.
posts.caption: India's aviation sector soars with new infrastructure projects across the country. Wings India 2026 paves the way for the future of Indian aviation — innovation, sustainability, and safety at the forefront.

posts.text: Had a fruitful meeting with Goa CM Pramod Sawant to discuss state development and progress. Will visit Tripura on June 5 to review border security along the India-Bangladesh border as part of a four-state security review tour.
posts.caption: Had a fruitful meeting with Goa CM Pramod Sawant to discuss state development and progress. Will visit Tripura on June 5 to review border security along the India-Bangladesh border as part of a four-state security review tour.

posts.text: 4 lakh students forced to seek answer sheets due to CBSE's broken On-Screen Marking system. Modi government's incompetence is destroying the futures of India's youth. No accountability, no answers.
posts.caption: 4 lakh students forced to seek answer sheets due to CBSE's broken On-Screen Marking system. Modi government's incompetence is destroying the futures of India's youth. No accountability, no answers.

posts.text: Medical education in UP will be enhanced using modern technology. In the last decade, medical college seats rose from 1,344 to 5,067 and MBBS seats from 5,390 to 12,800. We are building a healthcare revolution in Uttar Pradesh.
posts.caption: Medical education in UP will be enhanced using modern technology. In the last decade, medical college seats rose from 1,344 to 5,067 and MBBS seats from 5,390 to 12,800. We are building a healthcare revolution in Uttar Pradesh.

posts.text: We have to save the country from dictatorship. The Kejriwal Model is about schools, hospitals, electricity & dignity for every citizen. It was born in Delhi's jhuggis — not in corporate boardrooms.
posts.caption: We have to save the country from dictatorship. The Kejriwal Model is about schools, hospitals, electricity & dignity for every citizen. It was born in Delhi's jhuggis — not in corporate boardrooms.

posts.text: Chaired the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi. Our focus: maritime security, supply chain resilience, critical minerals, and energy partnerships. The Indo-Pacific demands collaborative solutions and the Quad delivers.
posts.caption: Chaired the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi. Our focus: maritime security, supply chain resilience, critical minerals, and energy partnerships. The Indo-Pacific demands collaborative solutions and the Quad delivers.

posts.text: Budget 2026 announces Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund and Rs 2,000 crore boost for micro enterprises. Reviving 200 legacy industrial clusters. MSMEs are the backbone of India's economy.
posts.caption: Budget 2026 announces Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund and Rs 2,000 crore boost for micro enterprises. Reviving 200 legacy industrial clusters. MSMEs are the backbone of India's economy.

posts.text: U.S. Justice Department has dropped all criminal charges against the Adani Group. No one in our group was charged with FCPA violations. Rs 6 lakh crore investment blueprint for India — aviation, clean energy, urban development, and manufacturing.
posts.caption: U.S. Justice Department has dropped all criminal charges against the Adani Group. No one in our group was charged with FCPA violations. Rs 6 lakh crore investment blueprint for India — aviation, clean energy, urban development, and manufacturing.

posts.text: Reliance signs $3 billion green ammonia deal with Samsung C&T — India's emergence as a green fuel exporter. Jio Platforms IPO filing in 2026 at $180 billion valuation. Building India's energy future.
posts.caption: Reliance signs $3 billion green ammonia deal with Samsung C&T — India's emergence as a green fuel exporter. Jio Platforms IPO filing in 2026 at $180 billion valuation. Building India's energy future.

posts.text: India's entrepreneurial spirit is its greatest strength. From startups to space, the nation continues to inspire the world with innovation rooted in purpose and values.
posts.caption: India's entrepreneurial spirit is its greatest strength. From startups to space, the nation continues to inspire the world with innovation rooted in purpose and values.

posts.text: Conferred the President's Police Colour on Sikkim Police — the 15th state to receive this honour. Urged police forces to embrace technology, address cybercrime, and become allies to public trust. Also launched the Pink Bus Service for women in Gangtok.
posts.caption: Conferred the President's Police Colour on Sikkim Police — the 15th state to receive this honour. Urged police forces to embrace technology, address cybercrime, and become allies to public trust. Also launched the Pink Bus Service for women in Gangtok.

posts.text: Iran thought they were going to outwait me. They thought wrong. I don't care about the midterms — I care about getting the deal done. Nobody negotiates like me!
posts.caption: Iran thought they were going to outwait me. They thought wrong. I don't care about the midterms — I care about getting the deal done. Nobody negotiates like me!

posts.text: If we can fix financial literacy, it's one of the most powerful things we can do to help people and improve social mobility. Four in ten people in the UK have poor financial literacy — that structural failing is holding our economy back.
posts.caption: If we can fix financial literacy, it's one of the most powerful things we can do to help people and improve social mobility. Four in ten people in the UK have poor financial literacy — that structural failing is holding our economy back.

posts.text: Date night in Cleveland. Let's go Cavs…all the way back!
posts.caption: Date night in Cleveland. Let's go Cavs…all the way back!

posts.text: Proud to support the work of American communities and families. The strength of this country lies in the values we pass to the next generation.
posts.caption: Proud to support the work of American communities and families. The strength of this country lies in the values we pass to the next generation.

posts.text: Accountability is coming. The American people deserve transparency from their government. We will continue to fight for truth and justice at every level.
posts.caption: Accountability is coming. The American people deserve transparency from their government. We will continue to fight for truth and justice at every level.

posts.text: AI policy should enable innovation while maintaining safety. Working on frameworks that keep America at the forefront of AI development while ensuring responsible deployment.
posts.caption: AI policy should enable innovation while maintaining safety. Working on frameworks that keep America at the forefront of AI development while ensuring responsible deployment.

posts.text: The World Bank is committed to scaling climate finance and supporting developing nations. Our mission: create a world free from poverty on a livable planet.
posts.caption: The World Bank is committed to scaling climate finance and supporting developing nations. Our mission: create a world free from poverty on a livable planet.

posts.text: Facing mounting pressure from cabinet on North Sea drilling policy. I remain committed to our net-zero agenda while acknowledging the wider economic benefits of domestic energy production. Britain's future depends on getting this balance right.
posts.caption: Facing mounting pressure from cabinet on North Sea drilling policy. I remain committed to our net-zero agenda while acknowledging the wider economic benefits of domestic energy production. Britain's future depends on getting this balance right.

posts.text: Welcomed Microsoft's $25 billion investment in Australia for the National AI Plan. This will expand digital infrastructure, strengthen cybersecurity, and train 3 million Australians with AI skills by 2028.
posts.caption: Welcomed Microsoft's $25 billion investment in Australia for the National AI Plan. This will expand digital infrastructure, strengthen cybersecurity, and train 3 million Australians with AI skills by 2028.

posts.text: La France continue de renforcer ses partenariats mondiaux. Working with G7 nations on de-escalation in the Middle East, economic cooperation, and strengthening EU security frameworks.
posts.caption: La France continue de renforcer ses partenariats mondiaux. Working with G7 nations on de-escalation in the Middle East, economic cooperation, and strengthening EU security frameworks.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead as a global hub for innovation and commerce. Our vision: a city that inspires the world with its ambition, tolerance, and forward-thinking leadership.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead as a global hub for innovation and commerce. Our vision: a city that inspires the world with its ambition, tolerance, and forward-thinking leadership.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: 2026 will be a big year for personal superintelligence. Meta is investing $115-135B in Superintelligence Labs. We may also enter cloud computing — our data center infrastructure is massive and growing.
posts.caption: 2026 will be a big year for personal superintelligence. Meta is investing $115-135B in Superintelligence Labs. We may also enter cloud computing — our data center infrastructure is massive and growing.

posts.text: At Google I/O 2026: AI's transformative potential is enormous. India's $15B AI hub in Vizag, El Salvador's AI healthcare, and our $180B CapEx strategy show the scale of commitment. 2026 is the year of agentic experiences. Will deliver Stanford's commencement address in June.
posts.caption: At Google I/O 2026: AI's transformative potential is enormous. India's $15B AI hub in Vizag, El Salvador's AI healthcare, and our $180B CapEx strategy show the scale of commitment. 2026 is the year of agentic experiences. Will deliver Stanford's commencement address in June.

posts.text: 2026 is AI's 'usefulness' year — moving from hype to impact. Models are scaffolding for human potential, not replacements. We need to focus on real-world outcomes, not raw capability. Copilot is becoming an embedded operating layer for everything.
posts.caption: 2026 is AI's 'usefulness' year — moving from hype to impact. Models are scaffolding for human potential, not replacements. We need to focus on real-world outcomes, not raw capability. Copilot is becoming an embedded operating layer for everything.

posts.text: I'm delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level, white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. AI is unlikely to lead to a 'jobs apocalypse' — the human part of employment is irreplaceable.
posts.caption: I'm delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level, white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. AI is unlikely to lead to a 'jobs apocalypse' — the human part of employment is irreplaceable.

posts.text: Apple announces John Ternus as CEO successor. After 14 years and growing Apple to a $4 trillion valuation, the next chapter begins September 2026. The best is yet to come for Apple.
posts.caption: Apple announces John Ternus as CEO successor. After 14 years and growing Apple to a $4 trillion valuation, the next chapter begins September 2026. The best is yet to come for Apple.

posts.text: Four years ago, Nvidia spent $10-15 billion a year in Taiwan. Now we're spending $100 billion, going to $150 billion each year. Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. Our new headquarters will break ground this year.
posts.caption: Four years ago, Nvidia spent $10-15 billion a year in Taiwan. Now we're spending $100 billion, going to $150 billion each year. Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. Our new headquarters will break ground this year.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure continues to set global standards. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC, the Indian stack is a blueprint for digital transformation worldwide.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure continues to set global standards. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC, the Indian stack is a blueprint for digital transformation worldwide.

posts.text: AI is transforming healthcare and education in remarkable ways. The key is ensuring these tools reach the people who need them most — not just in wealthy nations, but globally.
posts.caption: AI is transforming healthcare and education in remarkable ways. The key is ensuring these tools reach the people who need them most — not just in wealthy nations, but globally.

posts.text: IBM is at the forefront of enterprise AI adoption. Hybrid cloud and AI are transforming how businesses operate — from supply chains to customer service. The enterprise AI era is here.
posts.caption: IBM is at the forefront of enterprise AI adoption. Hybrid cloud and AI are transforming how businesses operate — from supply chains to customer service. The enterprise AI era is here.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe is building tools that empower creators to do their best work, faster and more intuitively than ever before.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe is building tools that empower creators to do their best work, faster and more intuitively than ever before.

posts.text: Building the future of technology requires both bold vision and disciplined execution. Excited about what's next in AI and decentralized systems.
posts.caption: Building the future of technology requires both bold vision and disciplined execution. Excited about what's next in AI and decentralized systems.

posts.text: Luxury is about human connection and craftsmanship. At Chanel, we're investing in the artisans and creative talent who make our maison extraordinary. People are always at the heart of everything.
posts.caption: Luxury is about human connection and craftsmanship. At Chanel, we're investing in the artisans and creative talent who make our maison extraordinary. People are always at the heart of everything.

posts.text: FedEx continues to innovate in logistics and supply chain management. AI-driven optimization is transforming how we deliver for customers around the world, faster and smarter.
posts.caption: FedEx continues to innovate in logistics and supply chain management. AI-driven optimization is transforming how we deliver for customers around the world, faster and smarter.

posts.text: First player to score 600 runs in four consecutive IPL seasons. RCB storms into the IPL 2026 final! Whenever I come back to play, it's 120%. The breaks keep me physically and mentally fresh.
posts.caption: First player to score 600 runs in four consecutive IPL seasons. RCB storms into the IPL 2026 final! Whenever I come back to play, it's 120%. The breaks keep me physically and mentally fresh.

posts.text: Tough season for MI, but we gave it everything. The boys showed character. Cricket teaches you to keep going — next season, we come back stronger.
posts.caption: Tough season for MI, but we gave it everything. The boys showed character. Cricket teaches you to keep going — next season, we come back stronger.

posts.text: CSK is home. The franchise means everything to me and always will. Every decision I make is about what's best for the team. The yellow jersey is not just a colour — it's a feeling.
posts.caption: CSK is home. The franchise means everything to me and always will. Every decision I make is about what's best for the team. The yellow jersey is not just a colour — it's a feeling.

posts.text: Not the IPL season I wanted — carried a slight niggle from the World Cup. Only 4 wickets in 13 matches. Time to reset, recover, and come back stronger for the international season ahead.
posts.caption: Not the IPL season I wanted — carried a slight niggle from the World Cup. Only 4 wickets in 13 matches. Time to reset, recover, and come back stronger for the international season ahead.

posts.text: Leading Mumbai Indians is a privilege. Tough season, but the dressing room spirit never wavered. We'll be back. The hunger to win stays the same.
posts.caption: Leading Mumbai Indians is a privilege. Tough season, but the dressing room spirit never wavered. We'll be back. The hunger to win stays the same.

posts.text: IPL 2026 has been a fantastic tournament. The emergence of young talent like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaking Chris Gayle's sixes record at just 15 — the future of Indian cricket is incredibly bright.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 has been a fantastic tournament. The emergence of young talent like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaking Chris Gayle's sixes record at just 15 — the future of Indian cricket is incredibly bright.

posts.text: What a season of IPL this has been. RCB vs the winner of the Eliminator in the final — can't wait for May 31 in Ahmedabad. Cricket at its absolute best.
posts.caption: What a season of IPL this has been. RCB vs the winner of the Eliminator in the final — can't wait for May 31 in Ahmedabad. Cricket at its absolute best.

posts.text: IPL 2026 Final: May 31 at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. RCB have qualified after a dominant 92-run win in Qualifier 1. Considering moving IPL window to September-October to address heat and player fatigue concerns.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 Final: May 31 at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. RCB have qualified after a dominant 92-run win in Qualifier 1. Considering moving IPL window to September-October to address heat and player fatigue concerns.

posts.text: Afghanistan squad named for upcoming Test series. Ireland impressed in T20I series. The global game continues to grow — more nations, more competition, more cricket fans worldwide.
posts.caption: Afghanistan squad named for upcoming Test series. Ireland impressed in T20I series. The global game continues to grow — more nations, more competition, more cricket fans worldwide.

posts.text: 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi surpasses Chris Gayle's record for most sixes in a single IPL edition! A 29-ball 97 with 12 sixes. RCB reach the final. The IPL 2026 season has been record-breaking!
posts.caption: 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi surpasses Chris Gayle's record for most sixes in a single IPL edition! A 29-ball 97 with 12 sixes. RCB reach the final. The IPL 2026 season has been record-breaking!

posts.text: Opening my season at the Jetour Doha Meeting in May — grateful for the incredible support from India. Parted ways with coach Jan Zelezny ahead of Asian Games 2026. New chapter, same hunger to compete.
posts.caption: Opening my season at the Jetour Doha Meeting in May — grateful for the incredible support from India. Parted ways with coach Jan Zelezny ahead of Asian Games 2026. New chapter, same hunger to compete.

posts.text: Every training session is a step closer to the dream. Working hard to represent India at the highest level and inspire the next generation of badminton players.
posts.caption: Every training session is a step closer to the dream. Working hard to represent India at the highest level and inspire the next generation of badminton players.

posts.text: Sports taught me resilience, discipline, and the courage to chase impossible dreams. Now it's about giving back and helping young Indian athletes find their path.
posts.caption: Sports taught me resilience, discipline, and the courage to chase impossible dreams. Now it's about giving back and helping young Indian athletes find their path.

posts.text: Intense start at Norway Chess 2026! Escaped a 144-move marathon against Keymer, then earned an Armageddon win. Every game at this level is a battle. Firouzja is playing incredible chess — stunning Carlsen in Round 1.
posts.caption: Intense start at Norway Chess 2026! Escaped a 144-move marathon against Keymer, then earned an Armageddon win. Every game at this level is a battle. Firouzja is playing incredible chess — stunning Carlsen in Round 1.

posts.text: Indian football has come a long way. The passion of our fans, the dedication of young players — the beautiful game is growing in India and nothing makes me prouder.
